controller.norm: WRMS, scale = atol + rtol*max(|y|,|y_new|), atol = rtol = tol
controller.note: stand-in controller, not the protected Rust controller

parameters.iteration: restricted additive Schwarz, Jacobi update, whole eight-stage chain per extended block

guesses.g1: previous accepted step's stage increments times h/h_prev

metric_definitions.endpoint_tol: WRMS(y_new_sweep - y_new_exact), scale = tol + tol*max(|y|,|y_new_exact|); index = sweep, 0 = initial guess
metric_definitions.endpoint_rel_err: endpoint_tol divided by the exact step's embedded error estimate WRMS(U_8)
metric_definitions.resid_max: max over the 8 stages of WRMS(h*gamma*R_i), R_i the original global stage residual, same scale
metric_definitions.resid_rms: root mean square over the 8 stages of the same
metric_definitions.sweeps_needed: first sweep with endpoint_tol <= 0.1; null if not reached within max_sweeps
